subject.title: TUI /sessions list: gateway-injected inbound metadata block used as session title (shows 'untrusted metadata' for all sessions)

question: Should maintainers ask the fork author to rebase https://github.com/BingqingLyu/openclaw/pull/148, manually adopt its useful diff, or authorize a new maintainer-editable replacement PR for this issue?
rationale: The bug is source-reproducible and narrow, but an open non-maintainer fork PR with closing syntax already targets it, is conflicting, and cannot be edited by maintainers, so automation should not race it without a branch-path decision.

options.title: Authorize a narrow replacement
options.body: Close or supersede the conflicting fork PR after opening a maintainer-editable replacement that covers the current sync, async, and agent-tool title paths.

options.title: Ask the fork author to rebase
options.body: Keep this issue paired to the existing fork PR and wait for the author to resolve conflicts and refresh proof.

options.title: Adopt the fork manually
options.body: A maintainer can cherry-pick the useful diff into an OpenClaw branch because maintainers cannot push to the fork PR.

recommendation.title: Authorize a narrow replacement
recommendation.body: Close or supersede the conflicting fork PR after opening a maintainer-editable replacement that covers the current sync, async, and agent-tool title paths.
